snippet.title: Operation Knockback Steam Announcment Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527400/Operation_Knockback/?beta=0

Game Features:
-Grapple-hook and shotgun-blast your way up a gigantic tower on a dying planet that wants to see you fall and break. Explore the unforgiving layers and solve puzzles -- or take shortcuts by exploiting push-n'-pull physics. 
-Using the blast recoil of an impulse device to push yourself and a grappling hook to pull yourself around harsh obstacles and unique puzzles, master a one-of-a-kind movement system that pushes the limits of player creativity and natural, fluid momentum to conquer a colossal tower that was made to break you. 
-Mistakes are not allowed in this classic foddian experience. Lose your footing, and you risk losing your progress. A lot of it. Additional optional ‘easy mode’ allows regular checkpoints to offer a more forgiving experience.

Also please note 50% of my developer profits after platform fees will be dedicated to charity for Gaza, which may include food packs and medical aid. Details and charity receipts will be posted on social media.
